answers.core: I explored the code for a few hours, and I don't think this could be done from the outside.
answers.workaround:
I tried many dark-magic tricks to achieve this without modifying code inside Godot or godot-cpp without success, so I don't believe it can be worked around easily.
The only workaround I found - suggested by TwistedTwigleg on the forum - would be to expose a way to manually clear this data in-editor before saving.
